memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and increase your numbers until you become a community of peoples. May he give you and your descendants the blessing given to Abraham, so that you may take possession of the land where you now reside as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.' Then Isaac sent Jacob on his way, and he went to Paddan Aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau." - Gen 28:3-5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This time Isaac blesses Jacob with full awareness, deliberately passing on "the blessing given to Abraham." He calls on "God Almighty" — the same name by which God had revealed Himself to Abraham (Gen 17:1) — trusting the all-powerful God to make Jacob fruitful and to keep the covenant promises alive in him.

What strikes us is the grace of it all. Jacob was a deceiver, freshly caught in a shameful scheme. Yet here he receives the highest blessing, and God's covenant purposes continue to flow through him. This is not because Jacob earned it, but because God had chosen to work through this flawed man. Grace, by definition, is undeserved.

The blessing promised that through Abraham's family "all peoples on earth" would be blessed — a promise that reached its fulfilment not in land or cattle, but in Jesus Christ, Abraham's greatest descendant (Gal 3:8, 16). Through Him, the blessing has spread to people of every nation, including us.

If you have ever felt too flawed to be used by God, look at Jacob. God's grace is not reserved for the impressive and the spotless. He delights to take ordinary, failing people and carry His purposes forward through them. His blessing rests on grace, not on our record.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do I believe God's grace can work through me despite my failures?
2. How does it move me that the blessing reached all nations through Christ?
3. Am I resting in grace, or trying to earn God's favour?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Almighty God, thank You that Your grace flows even through flawed people like me. Thank You that in Christ the blessing has reached every nation. Help me to rest in Your grace. Amen.
